title: npc
body:
<<if $parcelGiven>>
NPC: Thank you again for the parcel!
<<elseif $inventory.parcel>>
NPC: Is that my parcel? You found it!

[[Hand it over|npcParcel]]
[[Not yet|npcNotYet]]
<<else>>
NPC: I'm waiting for a parcel, but it was left on the highest platform outside.
NPC: Could you fetch it for me?
<<end>>

title: npcParcel
body:
<<removeItem, parcel>>
<<set $parcelGiven = true>>
You: Here you go.
NPC: Thank you! I've been waiting for this all day.

title: npcNotYet
body:
You: Not yet. I'll be back.
NPC: I'll be right here.
